evidence_snippets: Open a PowerShell terminal with administrator privileges by right-clicking the PowerShell icon and selecting Run as Administrator To restart the agent, run the following PowerShell command: Restart-Service google-cloud-ops-agent -Force To confirm that the agent restarted, run the following command and verify that the components "Metrics Agent" and "Logging Agent" started: Get-Service google-cloud-ops-agent Configure logs collection To ingest logs from CouchDB, you must create a receiver for the logs that CouchDB produces and then create a pipeline for the new receiver.
Any dashboards are automatically installed after you configure the integration and the Ops Agent has begun collecting metric data.
The integration collects general CouchDB and access logs and parses them into a JSON payload.
